titleStmt.title: Memorandum from the Acting Secretary of State to the President

keywords.term: Goodpaster, Brigadier General Andrew J., Jr.

div.head: PM–18. Memorandum from the Acting Secretary of State to the President

list.label: SUBJECT
list.item: United States Aide Memoire to Panama

div.p:
On July 6 the Panamanian Foreign Minister informed our Chargé d’Affaires and made a public announcement that he found unacceptable an Aide Memoire which had been presented to him by our Chargé. The Foreign Minister maintained that the Aide Memoire did not constitute a direct reply from you in response to a letter of March 7, 1959
from President de la Guardia objecting to certain features of the new merit system and wage scale procedure put into effect by Canal Zone authorities in February. Our Chargé reports that the Foreign Minister privately stated that the contents of the Aide Memoire appeared to offer little or no satisfaction to the Panamanian Government and the Chargé believes that objections were raised on procedural grounds solely in order to forestall criticism of the Government when the contents of the Aide Memoire are eventually made public.

I believe that the transmittal of your reply, dated April, 1959, to President de la Guardia and the subsequent delivery of the Aide Memoire were entirely correct and appropriate. However, rather than permit this incident to be further distorted out of proportion, I believe it advisable and would suggest that you approve the enclosed letter stating that the United States Government’s study of the points raised by the Panamanian Government’s memorandum has been completed and is being delivered in the form of an aide memoire through the usual diplomatic channels. If you approve this suggestion, I will instruct our Chargé, on presentation of the letter, orally to inform the Panamanian Foreign Minister that, although the Department regards the delivery of the Aide Memoire on July [illegible in the original] to have been correct diplomatic procedure, you are pleased to send another letter to President de la Guardia on this subject.
It is recommended that this letter, if approved, be released only on the initiative of the Panamanian Government.

note.p: Source: Department of State, Central Files, 811F.061/6–1159. Drafted by Leggett on July 10 and transmitted to the President under cover of a memorandum dated July 11 from John A. Calhoun, Director of the Executive Secretariat, to Brig. Gen. Andrew J. Goodpaster, the President’s Staff Secretary.
On June 24, the Department of State had transmitted the text of this Aide Memoire to Ambassador Harrington. (Airgram 211 to Panama City; 811F.061/3–3159)
For further information concerning the contents of President de la Guardia’s letter of March 7, see Rubottom’s memorandum of April 1 to the Acting Secretary of State, Document PA-11.
